=== OUTBOX account= recipients=primary@example.com ntfy=// reason=this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit
Dedup: acctchange|primary@example.com|primary@example.com|Someone used the quick picker to remove the rego from the permit “Visitor”. The permit has no rego now, so no car is covered by it until someone puts a rego on or the roster sets one.|email|primary@example.com
Subject: Someone made a change to your p.stonn account

Someone used the quick picker to remove the rego from the permit “Visitor”. The permit has no rego now, so no car is covered by it until someone puts a rego on or the roster sets one.

If you expected this change, you don’t need to do anything.
If you did not, open the Activity page in p.stonn, which lists every change and who made it. You can see who has shared access under Settings.

We have also told sam@example.com (by email).

https://p.stonn.org/activity
